observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A large indoor ballroom with polished wooden floor, a balcony/mezzanine with iron railings, and stage area at the back, during a social ball occasion
observation.dancers: A large group of mixed adult men and women dancing in couples
observation.formation_and_space: Couples arranged in sets, longwise lines, circles, and moving around the spacious hall floor
observation.posture: Upright torso, relaxed knees, weight shifting with steps
observation.footwork: Brisk walking or stepping patterns on the beat, occasional skips or chassés; precise foot placements are occluded by long dresses and low-resolution camera framing
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held loosely at sides or bent at elbows when connected with partner; hands holding partner's hand or held with white gloves
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso upright and relatively still with natural body sway during movement; hips not isolated
observation.partnering: Couples holding hands, leading and following in figures, circling, and changing partners within sets
observation.levels_jumps_turns: No jumps or floor work; gentle turns and swirling movements of couples
observation.costume_and_props: Regency-period historical attire: women in empire-waist long dresses, gloves, and bonnets or headpieces; men in tailcoats, waistcoats, breeches or trousers, cravats, and white gloves
observation.cannot_infer: Exact footwork details and weight transfers are obscured by long garments and distance; audio of live instruments is heard but not all visible in detail

Couples bow and curtsy facing each other
